_comment_channels: Set the two channel IDs separately. Each must resolve to its exact public Slack channel name at startup.

interaction_rules._comment_cooldown: Minimum seconds between XP gains per user. Prevents rapid-fire message spam.
interaction_rules._comment_base_xp: XP points awarded for any valid message.
interaction_rules._comment_long_message: Bonus XP awarded if message is longer than long_message_threshold characters.
interaction_rules._comment_suggestion: Bonus XP awarded if message contains suggestion or idea keywords.
interaction_rules._comment_level_up: Whether to post a public celebration message in the channel when a user levels up.
interaction_rules._comment_thread: Goose always replies in a thread: it continues the triggering thread, or starts one on the mention.

emoji_settings._comment_frequency: Controls how many emojis the bot uses. Options: 'none', 'low', 'moderate', 'high'
emoji_settings._comment_allowed: Approved emojis the bot is allowed to use in its responses and reactions.

profile._comment_pfp: Default fallback emoji icon if custom PFP avatar is not set in Slack App settings.

_comment_targets: Organizer channel receives the weekly Pond Report and alerts; owner_user_id confirms all-time results.

privacy._comment: Public boards list visible members; 0 means no size cap. Members default to visible and can run 'goose hide'.

voice._comment: LLM chat is on by default so the bot keeps talking; hourly_limit is per person per hour. Set enabled false to mute the voice.

rewards._comment: While announced is false, the runtime voice filter blocks these words from bot replies.

reactions._comment: Budget is per channel per hour; quiet members never get bot reactions.

roasts._comment: Rare, light roasts on harmless habits only. Never on distress or newcomers.

goose_meter._comment: Channel counter that rises when people call Goose a goose.

distress._comment: Plain safety reply plus an organizer alert on sad or unsafe messages.
distress.reply: Hey, I'm just a duck and I can't help with something this heavy, but you matter. If you're in danger or thinking about harming yourself, please reach out to a local emergency number or a crisis line right now. If you're in the US you can call or text 988. I've also pinged the organizers so a real human can check in on you.

season._comment: Season end as a Unix timestamp (0 = open-ended). Set with 'goose set-end'.

assets._comment: Rare reaction GIFs and generated sifu quotes. Uploads need the files:write bot scope. Cooldown is per channel.
